labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Giving Admin grants
labels.value: Configure giving and fix mistakes: funds, appeals, gifts, refunds and write-offs, including deleting a record entered by accident.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Giving Staff grants
labels.value: Enter gifts, record refunds, and set up funds and appeals, without deleting anything. The Fundraising Staff role already includes it.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Giving Read Only grants
labels.value: See gifts, funds, appeals and receipts without changing them.
